## Geographic & Property Scope
Davis & Garnett represents buyers, sellers, landlords, tenants, and landowners across **Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Manatee, Sarasota, Polk, and surrounding Central Florida / Gulf Coast corridors**, including:
- **Residential:** Single-family homes, historic bungalows (Hyde Park, Seminole Heights, Kenwood), Carrollwood & Northdale lake neighborhoods, South Tampa waterfront estates, Downtown Tampa / Water Street / St. Pete sky condos, Wesley Chapel / Starkey Ranch / Two Rivers new construction, and 55+ active-adult communities.
- **Commercial & Land:** Owner-occupied medical/professional offices (SBA 504 / 7a), retail strip plazas, NNN triple-net leases, industrial/warehouse flex bays (I-4 / I-75 / US-301), discreet Broker Price Opinions (BPOs), 1031 Tax-Deferred Exchanges, and Greenbelt / agricultural / development acreage (US-27 / US-98 / Central Florida).
